projectDescription: A TypeScript monorepo template for backtest-kit that runs 9 crypto symbols in parallel within a single Node.js process, featuring a zero-import dependency injection runtime, MongoDB persistence, and Redis caching for ~6300× real-time backtesting speed.
keyFeatures: ~6300× real-time aggregate backtesting speed across 9 crypto symbols in a single Node.js process
Zero-import DI runtime via globalThis.core — strategy files access services without any import statements
Parallel Backtest.background() execution sharing one event loop, one MongoDB connection pool, and one Redis pool
Redis O(1) lookup cache via BaseMap with configurable TTL, backed by ioredis
Atomic MongoDB upserts via BaseCRUD.findOneAndUpdate — no read-modify-write, no E11000 retries
Per-subsystem persistence adapters (live vs. backtest) configured in a single setup.config.ts
--cache flag pre-warms all symbol candles into MongoDB before the hot loop starts
Telegram MTProto scraper + regex-based signal parser for crypto trading signal channels
Rollup-based build per package emitting CJS bundles and rolled-up .d.ts type files
Four runtime modes: backtest, live, paper, and session (Telegram auth)
publicApiSurface: ioc — global DI container (globalThis.core) with loggerService, candleDbService, scraperService, parserService, cryptoYodaScreenService
BaseCRUD(Model) — factory class providing create, update, findById, findByFilter, findAll, iterate, paginate
BaseMap(connectionKey, ttlExpireSeconds) — Redis-backed map with set, get, delete, has, clear, toArray, iterate, keys, values, size
provide(TYPES.token, factory) — DI registration from di-kit createActivator('pro')
inject<T>(TYPES.token) — DI resolution
init() — initializes the DI container
LoggerService — log, debug, info, warn, setLogger
ScraperService.scrapeDay(channel, date) — fetches Telegram channel messages for a given day
ParserService.parseDay(messages, format) — extracts structured data from scraped messages using regex field mappings
CryptoYodaScreenService.screenDay(date) / parseDay(scraperList) — end-to-end signal extraction from CryptoYoda channel
CandleDbService.create(dto) / hasCandle(symbol, interval, timestamp) / findBySymbolIntervalTimestamp(...)
Backtest.background(symbol, { exchangeName, strategyName, frameName }) — non-blocking parallel backtest runner
Live.background(symbol, { exchangeName, strategyName }) — non-blocking live/paper trading runner
getArgs() — parses CLI flags: --entry, --backtest, --live, --paper, --session, --cache
CC_SYMBOL_LIST — comma-separated list of symbols for the parallel runner (env configurable)
addStrategySchema({ strategyName, getSignal }) — registers a strategy with backtest-kit
addExchangeSchema({ exchangeName, getCandles, getOrderBook, ... }) — registers an exchange adapter
addFrameSchema({ frameName, interval, startDate, endDate }) — registers a backtest time frame
listenActivePing(callback) — event hook called on every active position tick
listenError(callback) — global error handler hook
setup() — configures @backtest-kit/mongo persistence adapters
